name: United Kingdom (since 1922)
summary: The United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland after most of Ireland left in 1922: the centre of the British Empire until decolonisation, a founder of NATO, an EU member from 1973 to 2020.

knownFor.note: Free health care for everyone, paid for by taxes.

knownFor.note: Liverpool band that changed popular music.
